responsibility: Declares the core type indices and shared tables used by Arm MVE type support. It provides the generated enumeration of MVE predicate/vector type IDs and exposes the scalar_types and acle_vector_types arrays populated by the MVE type-registration implementation so other Arm frontend-support code can reference the registered MVE types.
same_name_distinction: Provides the exported enum of MVE type indices and declarations for the shared type tables populated by arm-mve-builtins.cc, while arm-mve-builtins.def is the underlying type list and the .cc file performs the actual frontend registration.
